6 تَجَارَوْا فِى الحَدِيثِ : see 3. Hence, in a trad., تَتَجَارَى بِهِمُ الأَهْوَآءُ (assumed tropical:) [Natural desires, or blamable inclinations, or erroneous opinions, contend with them for the mastery: or] they vie, or compete, one with another, in natural desires, &c. (TA.) ＝
-A2- See also 1.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
